snippet.title: Tribal Trouble Mobile Trailer
snippet.description:
Tribal Trouble is back, remade for Android! Out now on Google Play, free, no ads.
▶ https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.synthesisenterprises.tribaltrouble
🌴 https://tribaltrouble.app

Vikings vs Natives on a tropical island: gather wood, rock and iron, build your base, arm your warriors and storm the enemy camp. The classic 2000s cartoon real-time strategy game, rebuilt for touchscreens.

• Two story campaigns (Vikings, then Natives), playable offline
• Skirmish against the computer on a new island every time
• Online battles, ranked or just friendly
• Free: no ads                                                               
About this remake:  Tribal Trouble was created by Oddlabs (2005). Tribal Trouble Mobile is an unofficial Android remake by Synthesis Enterprises, made with the blessing of the original creator. It is not an official Oddlabs release.

Support: support@tribaltrouble.app

#TribalTrouble #RTS #AndroidGame
